A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same FrugalNeRF paper and Appendices A-G across 29 readable pages. Text comparison and rendered-page comparison support reliable assessment of the text, equations, tables, and figures.

before.justification: v2 reports original FrugalNeRF experiments on LLFF, DTU, and RealEstate-10K, including quantitative results, component ablations, convergence analyses, and qualitative comparisons in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments, including benchmark results in Tables 1, 2, and 17 and ablation studies in Section 4.2 and Appendix D.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Appendices B-C retain identical weight-sharing multi-scale voxels, reprojection-based pseudo-depth selection, novel-view regularization, and training losses, including optional monocular depth supervision.

E1.justification: Both evaluate the same novel-view synthesis tasks and scene coverage on LLFF, DTU, and RealEstate-10K. No dataset, domain, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership matches in every corresponding comparison, including VGOS in the appendix tables and ZeroRF on DTU. No baseline is added, removed, or revised.

E3.justification: Section 4 and Appendix E retain the same splits, input-view counts, preprocessing, PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS metrics, and training configurations. Appendix D's view-count and downsampling evaluation designs also match.

E4.justification: Section 4.2 and Appendix D contain identical analyses of scale count, weight sharing, losses, novel-view rays, training-view count, and downsampling. Scene-dependency and convergence analyses are also unchanged.

E5.justification: Both use the same statistical reporting, with identical point estimates and training curves. Neither discloses repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, or formal significance tests.

E6.justification: Numerical entries, plotted results, and qualitative comparisons match throughout both PDFs. For example, Table 1 reports two-view LLFF PSNR of 18.07 and 10-minute training for FrugalNeRF without learned priors in both versions.

T1.justification: Section 3's mathematical formulation and Appendix B's reprojection derivation, including Equations 1-19, are identical. No mathematical definitions, assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims concerning fast extreme few-shot synthesis, weight-sharing voxels, cross-scale geometric adaptation, and optional integration of learned priors.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations and result interpretations are identical. The limitations still concern accurate camera poses and generalization under large viewpoint changes or sparse coverage, including 360-degree scenes.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware, timing procedures, project URL, and code-release statements match. The added arXiv self-link provides no new code, data, or reproducibility information.

R1.justification: Section 2, Appendix A, and all 104 bibliography entries are unchanged, preserving the same discussion of competing methods and positioning relative to prior work.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv label changes from v2 dated 25 March 2025 to v3 dated 12 June 2025. The title, authors, manuscript wording, section organization, and appendix text are unchanged.

P2.justification: The arXiv stamp is slightly repositioned in the first-page margin. Figures 1-17, Tables 1-20, captions, and other page layout are unchanged; rendered pages 2-29 are pixel-identical.

improvement.justification: The scientific text, equations, experimental evidence, interpretations, limitations, and appendices are identical. Updates to the arXiv stamp, its placement, PDF metadata, and self-link do not meaningfully change the paper's clarity, evidential support, or reproducibility.
